h: פָּרָשַׁת כִּי תֵצֵא, ח׳ Ki Seitzei, 8
Opening the Heart to the Gates of Shabbos

p: הוּא כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר הַכָּתוּב (תְּהִלִּים קיח, יט)
this is as the verse says (Tehillim 118:19):
"Open for me the gates of righteousness";
'my perfect one' — with the letter tav;
my perfect one, for my head,"
which alludes to the letter beis,
הוּא עַל פִּי שֶׁאָמַר (בָּבָא בַתְרָא כה, א–ב)
this is based on what it says (Bava Basra 25a–b):
is closed on all its sides
between a house and an exedra
is that a house has doorposts
which is not so of an exedra,
where the whole side is open;
and that is the north side.
"From the north the evil shall open forth";
and this is as it says (Shabbos 104a):
And this is what the verse says:
that you open the entrance for Me,
that it bring to fear of Hashem;
and that they not let the yetzer hara,
and this is the letter beis.
"Open for me the gates of righteousness,"
which is the attribute of Malchus,
that his awe be upon you."
And corresponding to this is the Name Ad-nai,
the letter reish comes before the letter aleph.
regarding the time of the Giving of the Torah,
when the yetzer hara was uprooted
and it was said about them then:
that is, that they are in brotherhood
Which is not so in the word Bereishis,
which is said of the creation of the world,
these are the deeds of the wicked, etc.;
these are the deeds of the righteous, etc."
For then, at the beginning of thought,
that there would be deeds of the wicked,
that they are not in brotherhood by birth;
and therefore the reish comes first,
which have been arranged and coming
since the six days of Creation,
they shall become white as snow";
from the time it recognizes its mate,
does not exchange it for another,
and forbidden relations from the dove,"
for the dove recognizes its mate.
if one of them has pain in his head,
that were born at the same time,
for they are like one body;
at the creation of Adam HaRishon
"And He took one of his sides," etc.
for it is impossible to come
to the level of "my dove, my perfect one"
except with the word "for my head" coming first,
"'For my head is filled with dew'
which has the numerical value of 'tal, dew'";
that it be absorbed in the heart
to the level of "my dove, my perfect one."
who are called the Field of Apples.
